user.title: PhotoPrism Library
user.description: Adds your photo folder to the media browser. HEIC photos are converted to JPEG on the fly, and two extra folders show photos from this day in earlier years and a random selection.

data_description.folder: Folder as seen by Home Assistant, e.g. PhotoPrism's originals mounted at /media/photos.
data_description.extra_folders: Optional, comma separated. Needed when files in the photo folder are symlinks pointing elsewhere (only these folders are ever served).

error.folder_not_found: Folder not found inside Home Assistant.

data.skip_screenshots: Leave PNG/GIF (screenshots, animations) out of On this day and Random

data_description.allow_delete: Admins get a delete button on photo previews and on the PhotoPrism Library slideshow card. Deleting removes the photo's files from disk (Home Assistant needs write access to the photo folders) and cannot be undone.
data_description.photoprism: Remove the photo from PhotoPrism too, before the files are deleted.
data_description.photoprism_url: Only for the app password option, e.g. http://photoprism:2342
data_description.photoprism_token: Only for the app password option. Create one in PhotoPrism: Settings → Account → Apps and Devices. Leave empty to keep the saved one.

error.photoprism_integration_missing: The PhotoPrism integration is not set up.
error.photoprism_app_password_missing: Enter the PhotoPrism URL and an app password.

options.integration: Yes, using the PhotoPrism integration's connection
